t2.title: Technology make us more or less connected to other people
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Does technology make us more or less connected to other people?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Technology has fundamentally changed how we communicate. While it offers unprecedented ways to connect, I believe it paradoxically makes us less connected in meaningful ways.

Firstly, social media creates an illusion of connection. Having hundreds of online "friends" is not the same as having deep relationships. People often prioritize virtual interactions over face-to-face conversations, leading to superficial relationships.

Secondly, smartphone addiction damages in-person interactions. It's common to see families at restaurants all staring at screens rather than talking. This constant distraction reduces the quality of time spent together.

However, technology does help maintain long-distance relationships. Video calls allow grandparents to see grandchildren living abroad, and messaging keeps friends connected across continents. For isolated individuals, online communities provide valuable support.

The key is mindful usage. Technology should enhance rather than replace human connection.

In conclusion, while technology offers tools for connection, it often reduces the depth of our relationships. We must use it intentionally to maintain genuine human bonds.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I have new HomeHub. It is good. I like music. I talk to it. It is fun. My family too.
Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I have a HomeHub. It is good. It plays music and I can ask it questions. The setup was easy. I like it because it helps me. But my brother uses it too much and doesn't talk to me. I think technology is good but we need to talk to people too.
Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear Editor,
I want to write about technology and people. I think technology can help us connect, but it can also make us less connected. For example, I can talk to my friends online easily. However, sometimes I spend too much time on my phone and I don't see my friends in person. I think it's important to balance technology with real-life relationships. In my opinion, technology is a tool, and we need to use it wisely. If we only use technology, we might forget how to talk to each other face-to-face. It's important to remember that.
Sincerely,
Rayhona Yusupova
t2.sampleB2: Have you ever sat at a dinner table where everyone was glued to their phones? That single image sums up one of the biggest debates of our time: is technology bringing us closer together, or quietly driving us apart? On the bright side, technology has broken down the barriers of distance. A quick video call lets me chat with a cousin on the other side of the world as if she were in the next room. Social media helps us keep in touch with old friends we would otherwise lose track of, and online communities bring together people who share the same passions. On the flip side, there is a real danger. When we spend hours scrolling through our feeds, we often neglect the people sitting right beside us. Face-to-face conversations, with all their warmth and eye contact, are slowly being replaced by quick texts and emojis. In my opinion, technology itself is not to blame — it all comes down to how we use it. If we put our phones away during meals and make time for real conversations, technology can connect us rather than isolate us.
t2.uzSample:
Texnologiya bizning muloqot qilish usulimizni tubdan o'zgartirdi. U aloqa qilishning misli ko'rilmagan usullarini taklif qilsa-da, menimcha, u paradoksal ravishda bizni mazmunli aloqalardan mahrum qiladi.

Birinchidan, ijtimoiy media aloqa illyuziyasini yaratadi. Yuzlab onlayn "do'stlarga" ega bo'lish, chuqur munosabatlarga ega bo'lish bilan bir xil emas. Odamlar ko'pincha virtual muloqotlarni yuzma-yuz suhbatlardan ustun qo'yadilar, bu esa yuzaki munosabatlarga olib keladi.

Ikkinchidan, smartfonlarga qaramlik shaxsan muloqotga zarar yetkazadi. Restoranlarda oilalarning bir-biri bilan gaplashmasdan, ekranlarga tikilib o'tirganini ko'rish odatiy holga aylandi. Bu doimiy chalg'itish birgalikda o'tkazilgan vaqt sifatini pasaytiradi.

Biroq, texnologiya uzoq masofadagi munosabatlarni saqlashga yordam beradi. Video qo'ng'iroqlar bobo va buvilarga chet elda yashaydigan nabiralarini ko'rishga imkon beradi va xabarlar do'stlarni qit'alar bo'ylab bog'lab turadi. Izolyatsiya qilingan shaxslar uchun onlayn hamjamiyatlar qimmatli yordam beradi.

Muhimi - ongli foydalanish. Texnologiya insoniy aloqani almashtirish o'rniga, uni kuchaytirishi kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiya aloqa uchun vositalarni taklif qilsa-da, u ko'pincha munosabatlarimiz chuqurligini kamaytiradi. Biz undan chinakam insoniy aloqalarni saqlab qolish uchun ongli ravishda foydalanishimiz kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Menda yangi HomeHub bor. U yaxshi. Menga musiqa yoqadi. Men u bilan gaplashaman. Bu qiziqarli. Mening oilam ham.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menda HomeHub bor. U yaxshi. U musiqa chaladi va men unga savollar berishim mumkin. O'rnatish oson bo'ldi. Menga yoqadi, chunki u menga yordam beradi. Lekin akam undan juda ko'p foydalanadi va men bilan gaplashmaydi. Menimcha, texnologiya yaxshi, lekin biz odamlar bilan ham gaplashishimiz kerak.
Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli muharrir,
Men texnologiya va odamlar haqida yozmoqchiman. Menimcha, texnologiya bizga bog'lanishga yordam berishi mumkin, lekin u bizni kamroq bog'langan ham qilishi mumkin. Misol uchun, men do'stlarim bilan onlayn tarzda oson gaplasha olaman. Biroq, ba'zida men telefonimda juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazaman va do'stlarimni shaxsan ko'rmayman. Menimcha, texnologiyani haqiqiy hayotiy munosabatlar bilan muvozanatlash muhim. Mening fikrimcha, texnologiya - bu vosita va biz undan oqilona foydalanishimiz kerak. Agar biz faqat texnologiyadan foydalansak, biz bir-birimiz bilan yuzma-yuz qanday gaplashishni unutib qo'yishimiz mumkin. Buni esda tutish muhim.
Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Yusupova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Muharrirga,
Texnologiya bizning boshqalar bilan aloqamizni kuchaytiradimi yoki kamaytiradimi degan savol murakkabdir. Texnologiya, shubhasiz, masofalar bo'ylab aloqa qilish uchun vositalarni taqdim etsa-da, uning munosabatlarimiz sifatiga ta'siri ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'rib chiqishni talab qiladi.
Bir tomondan, ijtimoiy media va video konferensiya kabi platformalar bizga geografik to'siqlardan qat'i nazar, do'stlar va oila bilan aloqada bo'lish imkonini beradi. Ushbu vositalar yaqinlaridan uzoqda yashaydiganlar uchun bebaho bo'lishi mumkin. Biroq, ko'plab onlayn muloqotlarning yuzakiligi xavotirlarni uyg'otadi. Onlayn profillarning tartibga solingan tabiati ko'pincha hayotning noreal tasvirini taqdim etadi, hasadni va yetarli emaslik hissini kuchaytiradi. Bundan tashqari, doimiy bildirishnomalar va yangilanishlar oqimi chalg'ituvchi bo'lishi mumkin, bizni hozirgi lahzada mazmunli ishtirok etishdan uzoqlashtiradi.
Bundan tashqari, raqamli aloqaga tobora ko'proq tayanish muhim ijtimoiy ko'nikmalarni yo'qotishga olib kelishi mumkin. Yuzma-yuz suhbatlar faol tinglash, hamdardlik va noverbal ishoralarni nozik tushunishni talab qiladi. Ushbu ko'nikmalar kuchli munosabatlar o'rnatish uchun juda muhimdir va agar biz onlayn muloqotlarga shaxsan uchrashuvlardan ustunlik bersak, ular zaiflashishi mumkin.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiyaning bizning aloqadorligimizga ta'siri ko'p qirrali. U aloqa uchun misli ko'rilmagan imkoniyatlarni taqdim etsa-da, biz uning yuzakilikni, chalg'itishni va muhim ijtimoiy ko'nikmalarning pasayishini kuchaytirish potentsialidan xabardor bo'lishimiz kerak. Texnologik vositalar bilan bir qatorda chinakam insoniy muloqotga ustunlik beradigan muvozanatli yondashuv raqamli davrda mazmunli aloqalarni saqlab qolish uchun zarurdir.
Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Yusupova

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is interested in smart home technology. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! You mentioned wanting to make your home smarter, right? I just got a HomeHub device and it's genuinely life-changing! I can control lights, play music, and even set up reminders just by talking. It's incredibly convenient. You should definitely get one! Catch up soon!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Islom,
I have new HomeHub. It is good. I like it. You buy it? Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Islom,
I bought a HomeHub. It is very easy to use and it is fun. I can turn on the lights. You want a smart home, and I think you should buy it too. It's cool.
See you later!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Islom,
I wanted to tell you about the HomeHub I bought. It's pretty good! The setup was easy, and I can now control some things in my house with my voice. I think it's quite useful, especially for things like playing music or setting timers.
If you're thinking about getting a smart home device, I would recommend looking into it. It might be something you'd like.
Best,
Rayhona Yusupova
t11.sampleB2: Hey Islom, Guess what — I finally got that HomeHub thing we kept talking about, and honestly I'm hooked! I can dim the lights, play my favourite tunes and set reminders just by speaking. It's saved me so much hassle around the house. Knowing how much you love gadgets, you'd be over the moon with it. Go for it! Chat soon, Bekzod Aliyev
t11.uzSample:
Salom!

Uyingni aqlliroq qilishni xohlashing haqida aytgan eding, shundaymi? Men yaqinda HomeHub qurilmasini oldim va u rostdan ham hayotni o'zgartirmoqda! Men shunchaki gaplashish orqali chiroqlarni boshqarishim, musiqa qo'yishim va hatto eslatmalar o'rnatishim mumkin. Bu juda qulay. Senga albatta shundayini olishingni maslahat beraman!

Tez orada ko'rishguncha!
t11.uzSampleA1:
Salom, Islom,
Menda yangi HomeHub bor. U yaxshi. Menga yoqadi. Sen ham sotib olasanmi? Xayr.
t11.uzSampleA2:
Salom, Islom,
Men HomeHub sotib oldim. Undan foydalanish juda oson va qiziqarli. Men chiroqlarni yoqishim mumkin. Sen aqlli uy xohlaysan, va menimcha sen ham uni sotib olishing kerak. Bu zo'r.
Keyinroq ko'rishguncha!
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom, Islom,
Men sizga sotib olgan HomeHub haqida aytmoqchi edim. U juda yaxshi! O'rnatish oson bo'ldi va men endi uyimdagi ba'zi narsalarni ovozim bilan boshqara olaman. Menimcha, bu juda foydali, ayniqsa musiqa qo'yish yoki taymer o'rnatish kabi narsalar uchun.
Agar siz aqlli uy qurilmasini olish haqida o'ylayotgan bo'lsangiz, uni o'rganib chiqishingizni tavsiya qilaman. Ehtimol, bu sizga yoqadigan narsadir.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Rayhona Yusupova
t11.uzSampleB2:
Salom Islom,
Esimda bo'lsa, biz aqlli uy texnologiyalari haqida gaplashgandik? Xullas, men nihoyat HomeHub sotib oldim. Rostini aytsam, hayratdaman. Ovozni aniqlash juda aniq va uni mavjud aqlli qurilmalarim bilan integratsiya qilish juda oson bo'ldi.
Avtomatlashtirishga qiziqishingizni hisobga olgan holda, men sizga bu foydali bo'lishiga chin dildan ishonaman. U ko'plab kundalik vazifalarni soddalashtiradi va men yo'qotganimni bilmagan qulaylik qatlamini qo'shadi. Shunchaki bir fikr, lekin bu sizga mos kelishi mumkin.
Xayr,
Rayhona Yusupova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the smart device company. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear HomeHub Support Team, Thank you for inquiring about my experience with your smart assistant. I am very impressed with the device. The voice recognition is accurate, even understanding my accent perfectly. Connecting it to my lights and thermostat was surprisingly simple. The setup process took just minutes. However, I have encountered some issues. The device occasionally activates without being called, which is inconvenient. I would suggest improving the wake word detection accuracy. Additionally, the speaker quality could be better for music playback. For future development, I would appreciate integration with more third-party devices and a routine scheduling feature for automating daily tasks. Privacy controls that are easier to access would also give users more confidence. Overall, HomeHub has become essential in my home. Yours sincerely, Rayhona Yusupova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi HomeHub!

I have HomeHub. It is good. I like the lights. Easy to use. But sometimes no work. I want music. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hello HomeHub,

Thank you for the HomeHub. It is good and I like it. The lights are easy and the music is good too. But sometimes it doesn't work and that is bad. I want more things to work with HomeHub, like the TV. Please make it better. Thank you!

Bye,

Rayhona Yusupova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear HomeHub Support Team,

Thanks for your email. I'm writing to tell you what I think about the HomeHub. I think it's mostly good. The voice control works well, and it was easy to set up with my lights. However, sometimes it doesn't understand me, and that's annoying. Also, I think it needs more things to connect to, like my coffee machine. I would also like a better speaker for playing music. In my opinion, if you fix these things, it will be a much better product.

Sincerely,
Rayhona Yusupova
t12.sampleB2: Dear HomeHub Support Team, Thank you for reaching out about my recent purchase of the HomeHub Smart Assistant. On the whole, I am delighted with the device. The voice recognition is remarkably accurate, and it picks up my commands even from across the room. Setting it up was refreshingly straightforward — I had it running within minutes and connected it to my lights without a hitch. That said, there is room for improvement. The speaker quality falls short when playing music, and the device occasionally responds to background noise. I would strongly recommend fine-tuning the wake word detection. Looking ahead, support for a wider range of third-party devices and a customisable routine feature would make a real difference. Overall, though, HomeHub has quickly become part of my daily routine. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli HomeHub qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,

Sizning aqlli yordamchingiz bilan bog'liq tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Men ushbu qurilmadan juda ta'sirlanmadim. Ovozni aniqlash juda aniq, hatto mening shevamni ham mukammal tushunadi. Uni chiroqlarim va termostatimga ulash hayratlanarli darajada oson bo'ldi. O'rnatish jarayoni bir necha daqiqa davom etdi.

Biroq, men ba'zi muammolarga duch keldim. Qurilma ba'zan chaqirilmasdan ham faollashadi, bu noqulay. Men uyg'onish so'zini aniqlash aniqligini yaxshilashni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, dinamik sifatini musiqa tinglash uchun yaxshilash mumkin edi.

Kelajakdagi ishlanmalar uchun men ko'proq uchinchi tomon qurilmalari bilan integratsiyani va kundalik vazifalarni avtomatlashtirish uchun rutinani rejalashtirish funksiyasini qadrlagan bo'lardim. Shuningdek, kirish osonroq bo'lgan maxfiylik nazorati foydalanuvchilarga ko'proq ishonch beradi.

Umuman olganda, HomeHub mening uyimda muhim ahamiyatga ega bo'ldi.

Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Yusupova
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom, HomeHub!

Menda HomeHub bor. U yaxshi. Menga chiroqlar yoqadi. Ishlatish oson. Lekin ba'zida ishlamaydi. Men musiqa xohlayman. Xayr!
t12.uzSampleA2:
Salom HomeHub,

HomeHub uchun rahmat. U yaxshi va menga yoqadi. Chiroqlar oson va musiqa ham yaxshi. Lekin ba'zida u ishlamaydi va bu yomon. Men HomeHub bilan ko'proq narsalar ishlashini xohlayman, masalan televizor. Iltimos, uni yaxshiroq qiling. Rahmat!

Xayr,

Rayhona Yusupova
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli HomeHub qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,

Xatingiz uchun rahmat. Men sizga HomeHub haqida nima o'ylayotganimni aytish uchun yozyapman. Menimcha, u asosan yaxshi. Ovozli boshqaruv yaxshi ishlaydi va uni chiroqlarim bilan sozlash oson bo'ldi. Biroq, ba'zida u meni tushunmaydi va bu asabiylashadi. Shuningdek, menimcha, unga ko'proq narsalarni ulash kerak, masalan, kofe mashinamni. Men shuningdek, musiqa tinglash uchun yaxshiroq karnayni xohlardim. Mening fikrimcha, agar siz bu narsalarni tuzatsangiz, u ancha yaxshi mahsulot bo'ladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Yusupova
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli HomeHub qo'llab-quvvatlash jamoasi,

Yaqinda HomeHub xaridim bo'yicha kuzatuv xatingiz uchun tashakkur. Men odatda qurilmaning ishlashidan mamnunman. Ovozni tanish juda ishonchli va dastlabki sozlash oddiy edi. Mening mavjud aqlli qurilmalarim bilan integratsiya ham muammosiz bo'ldi.

Biroq, men yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar bor deb hisoblayman. Birinchidan, mos keluvchi qurilmalar diapazoni biroz cheklangan. Buni ko'proq turli xil brendlarni o'z ichiga olgan holda kengaytirish foydali bo'ladi. Ikkinchidan, men ovozli buyruqlarni bajarishda vaqti-vaqti bilan nosozliklarni sezdim, bu buyruqlarni takrorlashni talab qiladi. Bunga e'tibor qaratish foydalanuvchi tajribasini yaxshilaydi. Nihoyat, men ko'proq sozlanishi mumkin bo'lgan tartiblar va ulangan qurilmalarni boshqarish uchun yanada intuitiv interfeysni qadrlagan bo'lardim.

Umuman olganda, HomeHub mening uyim uchun qimmatli qo'shimcha, ammo bu yaxshilanishlar uning funksionalligi va foydaliligini sezilarli darajada oshiradi.

Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Yusupova
